mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (customer_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, property_name, memo) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{reservationDate}, #{reservationTime}, #{propertyName}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id AS customerId, reservation_date AS reservationDate, reservation_time AS reservationTime, property_name AS propertyName, memo FROM reservation ORDER BY reservation_date,reservation_time,id
